dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: She moves much like perfume herself. You cannot reach her, nor can she be stopped.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: She is not employed by the Confrerie of Cabriere, nor does she work with any fixed brand.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: But still, she remains the most famous perfume designer in Fontaine. The elegant, fashionable ladies of Fontaine would even give a precious gem for her perfume.

dialogues.speaker: Calcagni
dialogues.text: Hmm... In that case, simply take it as if I added a "so I've heard" to that statement.
